verdict.rationale: Spinning up a local or dev instance is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The pack never documents running the Elastic platform itself (Elasticsearch/Kibana) locally or in a dev environment. Running an Elastic Agent in a container covers the data-collection agent, not a platform instance, and the llms.txt 'open source' description does not document local deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up a local or dev instance of the platform to test instrumentation and dashboards
